```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(MuMIn)
library(lmerTest)
library(ggpubr)
library(rstatix)
library(car)
library(emmeans)
library(multcomp)
library(mgcv)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
raw_data <- read.csv("MCM_SoilOC_2007-2016_preprocessed.csv")

summary(raw_data)
head(raw_data)

```

```{r}
new_data <- raw_data %>%
  dplyr::select(Year, BLOCK_ID, TREATMENT, TOTAL_ROTIFERS, TOTAL) %>%
  filter(!is.na(TOTAL_ROTIFERS), !is.na(TOTAL)) %>% 
  group_by(Year, BLOCK_ID, TREATMENT) %>%
  summarise(Total_abundance_per_kg = sum(TOTAL_ROTIFERS, TOTAL)) 

new_data
write.csv(new_data, "MCM_SoilOC_2007-2016_processed.csv")
```
